name: Bellingham Country Gardens
description: A working apple orchard in 2838 Kelly Road, WA, Bellingham Country Gardens grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The orchard is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
